text: {"differences":[{"evidence":"Master's degree from Stanford vs Bachelor's degree from Kennesaw State","dimension":"academic pedigree","description":"This captures the level and selectivity of the applicant's formal computer science education.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"5 years at Microsoft vs 7 years at Bluegrove","dimension":"industry tenure","description":"This captures how much total professional software-development experience the letter emphasizes.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"I want my next role to sit at the foundation layer\"","dimension":"motivation framing","description":"This captures whether the letter explicitly frames the candidate's reason for wanting the role in terms of strategic mission or impact.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"modern AI directly\" and \"language models into production workflows\"","dimension":"AI depth","description":"This captures the extent to which the applicant presents hands-on experience with AI systems relevant to the role's agentic tooling.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"I earned the OSCP certification\"","dimension":"security credentials","description":"This captures explicit external evidence of security-assessment skill and offensive-security familiarity.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"Security work is the rare kind of engineering...\" opening","dimension":"rhetorical polish","description":"This captures the degree to which the letter uses a polished, thematic opening to set up the applicant's fit for security engineering.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"I join capture-the-flag competitions regularly\"","dimension":"hands-on security practice","description":"This captures evidence of active, practice-oriented engagement with security beyond formal job duties.","winner":"A"}]}
